svg.title: One section of a stadium seat map during an on-sale
svg.desc: Six rows of twelve seats. Red seats are sold, amber seats are held with the minutes left on each hold, blue seats are the ones you are picking, empty seats are available. One amber seat in row D shows 0 minutes left: the hold has expired, so the next hold UPDATE will take it even before the cleanup job resets it.
svg.text: section 112, about four minutes into the on-sale
the 0 in row D has expired: it still looks held, but the
next UPDATE sees hold_expires_at < now() and takes it
